Package persist.hibernate.enhance.legacy

package persist.hibernate.enhance.legacy
Legacy (javax) Persistence Hibernate bytecode enhancement implementation.

This package provides the HibernateEnhancer and HibernateEnhancerProvider implementations that target the javax.persistence namespace (JPA 2.x). It uses the Hibernate 5 bytecode enhancement SPI to transform compiled entity classes at build time.

  • LegacyHibernateEnhancer – enhances entity class bytes using Hibernate 5, configured with a set of HibernateEnhancer.Option flags.
  • LegacyHibernateEnhancerProvider – registered as a ServiceLoader provider for HibernateEnhancerProvider.
Since:
1.0.0
